title: Craft crash in northern Iran
summary: Steven Greer tells of Craft crash in northern Iran, about an unknown time at Northern Iran, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there was one that crashed and went down in northern Iran that we had to try to go in and

plain: A UFO researcher and activist, Steven Greer, says on a podcast that a craft of unknown origin crashed in northern Iran, and that the United States had to try to go in and get it. He gives no date. If true, it would mean the US has secretly recovered such objects even from inside hostile countries.
